why_no_comparison: the cutover falls inside the sealed 2025 holdout, and config/data.yaml stops fetching at 2024, so there is no post-cutover row in this project to compare against. The flag is therefore a statement about the evaluated window, not a split: every price hour behind every number in C13 was served at 60-minute resolution (manifest resolution_seconds=3600 on all 54 zone-years) and falls before 2025-10-01. data/contracts.py carries the resolution-change detection that would catch a post-cutover file if a later cycle fetched one; PLAN.md C15+ keeps native 15-minute analysis as a labelled stretch goal that is never blended into these results.
